source_scope: Only 2004-2013 WTH headers were read for station metadata; no validation-year daily weather values were opened or used.

field_units.latitude: degrees north (official legacy WeatherMan climate-file specification)
field_units.longitude: degrees east (official legacy WeatherMan climate-file specification)

train_weather_header_audit.consistency: All ten 2004-2013 WTH headers agree exactly at stored precision.

TAV.status: same in all ten train-period file headers, but estimation period/source is not documented; do not use as train-only CLI statistic

AMP.status: same in all ten train-period file headers, but estimation period/source is not documented; do not use as train-only CLI statistic

REFHT.status: sentinel/unknown, not a usable instrument height

WNDHT.status: sentinel/unknown, not a usable anemometer height

site_and_station_code_interpretation.YC: Confirmed project/site label from the YC directory and experiment context.
site_and_station_code_interpretation.CNYC: Confirmed full four-character station identifier from WTH headers and official station-code conventions.
site_and_station_code_interpretation.CN_component: The repository does not formally define the substring CN; do not claim a validated semantic expansion.
site_and_station_code_interpretation.YC_component_inside_CNYC: The repository does not formally define the substring YC within CNYC; do not claim a validated semantic expansion.

legacy_weatherMan_new_station_fields.latitude: Known and consistent from ten train-period headers; official legacy guide calls it essential.
legacy_weatherMan_new_station_fields.longitude: Known and consistent from ten train-period headers.
legacy_weatherMan_new_station_fields.elevation_m: Known and consistent from ten train-period headers.
legacy_weatherMan_new_station_fields.angstrom_A_B: Not present in audited WTH headers; not derived from another station or guessed.
legacy_weatherMan_new_station_fields.mean_annual_temperature_TAV: Header value 14.0 is repeated, but its climate reference period is unknown; must be recomputed from frozen 2004-2013 data or verified as compatible with the train-only protocol.
legacy_weatherMan_new_station_fields.temperature_amplitude_AMP: Header value 28.9 is repeated, but its climate reference period is unknown; must be recomputed from frozen 2004-2013 data or verified as compatible with the train-only protocol.
legacy_weatherMan_new_station_fields.start_of_growing_season_START: Not present in audited WTH headers; source and method unresolved.
legacy_weatherMan_new_station_fields.duration_of_growing_season_DURN: Not present in audited WTH headers; source and method unresolved.
legacy_weatherMan_new_station_fields.guide_caveat: These fields are listed as new-station information by the legacy DSSAT v3 WeatherMan guide; requiredness in the target current 4.8.x build must be checked in its Help/About.

filex_and_weather_mapping.weather_mode_w_cli_filename_rule: The inspected official public DSSAT 4.8.5 SECLI source writes '.CLI' into FILEW characters 5-12 for internal WGEN/SIMMETEO modes, leaving the leading four-character prefix. For WSTA CNYC0801, the source-level derived basename is CNYC.CLI.
filex_and_weather_mapping.internal_cli_header_match: Repository examples use *CLIMATE:CNYC. Strict runtime validation that the internal climate identifier must equal the filename prefix was not executed.
filex_and_weather_mapping.source_runtime_relation: Static source rule only; active local runtime version and file lookup were not tested.

next_action: Before generating, preserve the confirmed station ID/location; verify instrument heights and any additional metadata requested by the actual WeatherMan version. Do not copy another station's climate parameters.
